title: NoFriendDamage
description: It doesn't allow you to hit players you've added as friends.
body:
NoFriendDmage is a lightweight and convenient mod that prevents you from hitting your friends during PvP, so you can fight side by side without worrying about friendly fire.

✨ Features:

Blocks damage to added friends, keeping your allies safe.

Client-side only — no need to install on the server.

Simple and easy to use with a friend list system.

Perfect for PvP, team battles, and cooperative play.

🎮 Why download:
If you often fight with friends in Minecraft, this mod makes PvP smoother and more enjoyable. No more accidents or wasted hits — focus on your enemies, not on avoiding your teammates!
